_comment: Smallest panel verified to TRAIN WELL and exercise the kit's metrics, on DATA_CANDI_EIC. 3 well-behaved marks x 6 biosamples, chr19 train / chr21 eval. Two properties matter and are easy to lose when you edit this: (1) each T_ biosample carries >=2 panel assays, or whole-assay cloze is skipped and the imputation loss is identically 0; (2) the held-out targets span MORE THAN ONE assay (DNase-seq and H3K4me1 here) -- with a single held-out assay the M2 cross-target assay ablation has nothing to swap and returns nan. Keys starting with _ are ignored, so annotate your own panels freely.
